en.hubeali: H 14463 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Fazaal, from Sa’albat Bin Maymoun, from Badr Bin Al-Khaleel Al-Asady who said: ‘I heard Abu Ja’farasws saying regarding the Statement of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic:

“[21:12] Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it. [21:13] Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.”

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> makes the stand, and sends (an army) to the Clan of Umayya in Syria, so they will run away to ‘al-Rome’.
So the Romans will say to them, ‘We will not let you enter until you become Christians’. So they will hang crosses upon their necks and allow them to enter. So when the companions of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> descend upon them, they (Romans) will seek security and reconciliation. So the companions of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> will say, ‘We will not do that until you hand over to us the ones who came to you beforehand from us’. So they will hand them over.
So that is Hisazwj Statement: “[21:13] Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account”.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So he<sup>asws</sup> will question them about the treasure although he<sup>asws</sup> knows more than them about it. So they will say, ‘O woe be upon us! Surely we have been unjust’. They will not cease invoking that invocation of theirs until they will be cut down to extinction by the sword’.
